text:
Root cause: option declarations were stored in the parser using their original casing, while command-line inputs were normalized before lookup. Thus normalized inputs could not match declarations containing uppercase letters.

Updated option registration to normalize short and long option names before adding them to the parser’s lookup maps. Existing normalization and option tests pass: **529 passed**.

final_text:
Root cause: option declarations were stored in the parser using their original casing, while command-line inputs were normalized before lookup. Thus normalized inputs could not match declarations containing uppercase letters.

Updated option registration to normalize short and long option names before adding them to the parser’s lookup maps. Existing normalization and option tests pass: **529 passed**.
